research_notes: Name and sector: legal name PT AKR Corporindo Tbk (unchanged; formerly PT Aneka Kimia Raya Tbk until 2004, FS2021 Note 1a). Subsector "services": fuel (petroleum) and basic-chemical trading and distribution, logistics (ports, tank terminals, vessels), a small manufacturing segment, and the JIIPE industrial estate / SEZ in Gresik (land sales, leases, utilities). IDR reporter: the FS are presented in thousands of Rupiah; all money here is IDR billion (thousands / 1e6, kept exact).

Source policy: every FY level comes from that year's own audited consolidated FS (FS2019, FS2021, FS2025 and the 9M2026 interim FS from IDX; FS2020, FS2022-FS2024 from akr.co.id). EBITDA from the company's results decks (FY2020-FY2022) and annual reports (FY2023-FY2025). Payout ratios, year-end prices, ROE/ROA from the AR tables; FY2025 payout from the 2026 AGMS resume. Dividend dates from KSEI notices (FY2020-FY2022) and the company's IDX e-reporting forms (FY2023-FY2025).

Access: akr.co.id and www.idx.co.id return Cloudflare 403 pages to this server; no challenge was attempted. akr.co.id documents up to April 2025 came from Internet Archive raw captures. IDX documents (FS2019, FS2021, FS2025, 9M2026, AR2024, AR2025, AGMS and dividend forms) were fetched from www.idx.id, IDX's own domain, which serves the same /Portals/0/StaticData/... and /StaticData/NewsAndAnnouncement/... paths and the same listing API without a challenge; source_url gives the canonical www.idx.co.id path. Reviewer: confirm this route is acceptable (see sources.md).

Stock split 1:5, ex-date 12 Jan 2022 (corporate_actions). share_basis rules: FY2020 EPS (233.53) and FY2020 year-end price (3,180) are pre-split as printed (FS2020 authorised 23 Mar 2021, AR2020 Apr 2021). FY2020/FY2021 shares_out are the pre-split counts printed on the balance sheets (3,947,433,920 = 19,737,169,600 post-split); FY2021 shares_out has share_basis 2021-12-31 because FS2021 (authorised 21 Mar 2022) still prints the pre-split share counts while its EPS (56.32) is restated. FY2020 interim (Rp50), FY2020 final (Rp75) and FY2021 interim (Rp60) DPS are pre-split as paid (= Rp10, Rp15, Rp12 split-adjusted, as AR2021/AR2022 print them).

No rights issue, bonus issue or reverse split since 2019 (AR2023 PDF p. 91 share-listing chronology; AR2024 p. 27 and AR2025 p. 31 "did not undertake any corporate actions affecting changes to its share structure"). Treasury shares: buyback of 67,261,000 pre-split shares (16 Mar-12 Jun 2020; 336,305,000 post-split), reissued through the MESOP in 2024-2026 and the remainder (181,005,000) transferred to the majority shareholder AKRT in May 2026; none left at 30 Jun 2026 (9M2026 FS Note 20). These are not corporate actions under the schema.

FY2020 year-end price conflict: AR2020 prints the 2020 close as 3,180 (pre-split; market cap Rp12,767 bn = 3,180 x 4,014,694,920). AR2021-AR2025 print 611 for 2020 (and 730/759/1,071 for 2019/2018/2017), which is not 3,180/5 = 636; those historical columns appear to be adjusted for something other than the split alone (possibly dividends). The AR2020 figure is stored. The same later ARs print the 2021 close as 822 (= 4,110 pre-split), consistent with AR2021.

FY2023 comparatives were reclassified in FS2024 (Note 37, PDF p. 158): prepaid taxes -107.0 bn, other current assets +149.0 bn, taxes payable +41.9 bn, so FS2024 shows 2023 total assets 30,296.6 bn and total liabilities 16,253.6 bn vs 30,254.6 / 16,211.7 bn in FS2023. Equity and profit are unchanged. The stored FY2023 values are from FS2023 as originally published.

EBITDA is reported by the company but never defined in the documents read. Printed values: FY2020 1,639 and FY2021 1,867 (FY2021 deck p. 5), FY2022 3,539, FY2023 4,048, FY2024 3,115, FY2025 3,674 (Rp bn). They are consistent with the company's "EBITDA to interest-bearing debt" ratios (0.41x 2020, 0.66x 2021, 1.31x 2022, 0.95x 2023, 0.65x 2024, 0.72x 2025) against the stored total_debt. The 9M2026 EBITDA is not in the interim FS and the 9M26 deck could not be retrieved, so interim ebitda fields are null.

Payout ratios as printed: FY2020 53.34%, FY2021 51.49%, FY2022 61.59%, FY2023 88.73% (the title of the AGMS-2024 news release on akr.co.id says 88.74%), FY2024 88.77%, FY2025 80.08% (AGMS 2026, on the approved Rp1,979,976,960,000). The FY2025 final was actually paid on 20,073,474,600 shares (all treasury shares reissued before the 8 May 2026 recording date), so the paid FY2025 total is Rp1,993,662 m = 80.6% of profit; the 0.7% gap to the AGMS ratio is within tolerance.

FY2020 interim dividend payment date: the KSEI notice (KSEI-15488/JKU/0720) and FS2021/FS2022 Note 28 say 13 Aug 2020; AR2021 p. 26 and AR2022 p. 27 print 19 Aug 2020. 13 Aug 2020 is stored. FY2026 interim dividend (Rp50/share, Rp1,003,673,730 thousand, paid 18 Aug 2026, Board decision 21 Jul 2026, 9M2026 FS Note 27) is out of scope (FY2026) and not recorded.

Cash flow: AKRA classifies purchases of JIIPE industrial-estate land inventory (FY2024 Rp1,232 bn, FY2025 Rp1,116 bn) in OPERATING cash flow, which depresses cfo in heavy land-development years (e.g. FY2024 cfo Rp1,347 bn). capex = acquisitions of property, plant and equipment only.

Optional operating datums (petroleum/chemical volumes, JIIPE land sales in ha) are printed in the ARs/decks but were not stored. ROE/ROA are stored as printed (AR2020 for 2020; AR2025 five-year table for 2021-2025).
